system.boundary: Build a complete complex-baseband terrestrial digital-video packet link in Simulink using the DVB-T 2k-mode signal structure.
engineering_objects: F90-XCOMM-08 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: SourcePackets, RSCodedBytes, InnerCodedBits, TxQAMSymbols, TxOFDMWaveform, RxOFDMWaveform, SoftMetrics, InnerDecodedBits, RecoveredPackets, InnerBERStats, OuterBERStats
physical_paths: A source of 188-byte packets must pass through shortened Reed-Solomon (204,188) outer coding, outer convolutional interleaving, rate-3/4 punctured convolutional coding, DVB-T bit and symbol interleaving, nonhierarchical normalized 64-QAM mapping, 2048-point OFDM modulation, and an AWGN channel.

Each signal must come from its actual connected processing stage and retain that stage's public data type: packet bytes, coded bits or bytes, complex QAM or OFDM samples, soft metrics, or recovered packet bytes as applicable.
functional_paths: The receiver must perform OFDM demodulation, soft 64-QAM demapping, matching inner deinterleaving and Viterbi decoding, outer deinterleaving, Reed-Solomon decoding, and packet recovery.
Across the declared SNR and seed range, the full receiver must recover source packets and must expose both the post-inner-decoder and final post-outer-decoder error measurements.

Log MATLAB Timeseries named SourcePackets, RSCodedBytes, InnerCodedBits, TxQAMSymbols, TxOFDMWaveform, RxOFDMWaveform, SoftMetrics, InnerDecodedBits, RecoveredPackets, InnerBERStats, and OuterBERStats.
